draft.subject: Robotics Electrical Engineering Intern | Justin Mascarenhas
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I applied for the Robotics Electrical Engineering Intern role at RoboForce and wanted to reach out, since your role spans the technical side broadly and you might know who owns hiring for the hardware and firmware team.

My background is hands on embedded work. I built an object tracking system where a Linux based Jetson host sends detection commands to an STM32 microcontroller over UART, using FreeRTOS with mutexes for task coordination and a time of flight sensor for distance sensing. I have also programmed STM32 peripherals in bare metal C and fabricated PCBs in Eagle.

If you have a few minutes, I would appreciate a short call to talk through what the team looks for in this role, or point me toward whoever runs the hiring process for it.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
